name: F-box and WD repeat domain containing 7

function.text: FBXW7 encodes f-box/WD repeat-containing protein 7. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. It participates in lipid homeostasis and protein stabilization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to developmental delay, hypotonia, and impaired language (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Colorectal adenocarcinoma; Serous carcinoma of endometrium; Squamous cell carcinoma of cervix. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: FBXW7 encodes f-box/WD repeat-containing protein 7. It participates in lipid homeostasis and protein stabilization.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with developmental delay, hypotonia, and impaired language (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FBXW7 have been reported in colorectal adenocarcinoma, serous carcinoma of endometrium, and squamous cell carcinoma of cervix.
